Name: Chronoblast
Overview:
XBLIGs first shooter with full TATE support! Vertical manic shooter based on various arcade classics. Various modes of play. Challenging risk/reward scoring system. Online networked scores for competitive play.

Unleash the power of super mode for maximum scoring in single ranked games, or co-op with a friend using one of 4 ships up against enemies guaranteed to crush you with fearsome fire power!
